title: 第2章 干好莱坞一炮
content_zh:
“你知道的，我是南加州大学导演系的。”

    陆穿点了点头，其实我不知道。

    谷川说道：“罗伯特·泽米吉斯导演特别欣赏我，我是通过他的关系，搞到的版权。”

    “罗伯特·泽米吉斯是谁，你知道吧？”

    “当然知道，《阿甘正传》的导演。”陆穿点头。

    《阿甘正传》是好莱坞经典电影，罗伯特·泽米吉斯导演声名显赫。

    陆穿震惊的看着谷川。

    看来他在好莱坞真的有人脉，不愧是南加州大学导演系。

    陆穿好奇的问道：“你说的大热电影的翻拍权，是什么电影的？”

    “《女巫布莱克》。”谷川说道。

    “女巫布莱克？”陆穿眉头皱了皱。

    这个电影，他好像听说过，但一时间没有想起来。

    谷川给他介绍道：“这是一部跨时代的电影，开创了伪纪录片这个类型，以6万美元的成本，创造了全球超2.5亿美元的票房奇迹。”

    “6万美元？2.5亿美元？”陆穿大吃一惊。

    这两个数字的对比，实在是令人惊悚。

    “没错。”谷川点头。

    拍摄成本就6万美元，至于宣发成本，嗯，不重要。

    “你真有授权？”陆穿问道。

    “那当然！”

    谷川从兜里拿出授权书，递给陆穿看。

    陆穿仔细看了看。

    授权书全英文，授予大陆地区（不含港澳台）独家翻拍权，限定3年内完成开发。

    这写的明明白白，不像是假的。

    谷川继续对陆穿诱惑道：“这种电影，是有可能在好莱坞上映，甚至全球上映的。”

    “去好莱坞？”

    “当然。”谷川说道：“你是知道的，我是南加州大学导演系的，在好莱坞颇有人脉。”

    “到时候，我给电影运作一个美国的奖项，然后在好莱坞上映，不成问题。”

    陆穿被谷川说的心动了。

    现在国内有谁的电影，能在好莱坞上映？

    连老谋子都不行。

    如果真能去好莱坞，他就是国内第一人了。

    不过，他看了一眼谷川。

    太年轻了，感觉很不靠谱的样子。

    但陆穿还是难掩心动的问道：“你能运作奥斯卡？”
content_en:
"You know, I'm from the directing department at the University of Southern California."

    Lu Chuan nodded, actually I don't know.

    Tanigawa said: "Director Robert Zemeckis particularly admired me, and I obtained the copyright through his relationship."

    "You know who Robert Zemeckis is, right?"

    "Of course I know, the director of "Forrest Gump"." Lu Chuan nodded.

    "Forrest Gump" is a classic Hollywood movie directed by Robert Zemeckis.

    Lu Chuan looked at Tanichuan in shock.

    It seems that he really has connections in Hollywood, as expected from the directing department of the University of Southern California.

    Lu Chuan asked curiously: "What movie are you talking about about the remake rights of the popular movie?"

    "Witch Black," Tanigawa said.

    "Witch Black?" Lu Chuan frowned.

    He seemed to have heard of this movie, but he didn't think of it for a while.

    Tanigawa introduced to him: "This is a cross-era film that created the genre of pseudo-documentary. With a cost of US$60,000, it created a global box office miracle of over US$250 million."

    "USD 60,000? USD 250 million?" Lu Chuan was shocked.

    The comparison between these two numbers is really horrifying.

    "That's right." Tanichuan nodded.

    The shooting cost was only US$60,000. As for the publicity cost, well, it doesn’t matter.

    "Do you really have the authority?" Lu Chuan asked.

    "Of course!"

    Tanichuan took out the authorization letter from his pocket and handed it to Lu Chuan to read.

    Lu Chuan looked carefully.

    The authorization letter is in English, granting the exclusive rights to remake the film in mainland China (excluding Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan), and is limited to completing development within 3 years.

    This is clearly written and does not look like a lie.

    Tanichuan continued to seduce Lu Chuan: "It is possible for this kind of movie to be released in Hollywood or even around the world."

    "To Hollywood?"

    "Of course." Tanigawa said, "As you know, I am from the directing department of the University of Southern California and have quite a lot of connections in Hollywood."

    "When the time comes, it won't be a problem for me to give the film an American award and then release it in Hollywood."

    Lu Chuan was moved by what Tanichuan said.

    Whose domestic movies can be released in Hollywood now?

    Not even Lao Mouzi.

    If he can really go to Hollywood, he will be the first person in the country.

    However, he glanced at Tanichuan.

    He is too young and seems very unreliable.

    But Lu Chuan still couldn't hide his excitement and asked: "Can you operate Oscar?"
